summary: Browse your notes by folder, tag, link, and backlink.
page_description: Keep a searchable copy of your note library ready to read on your Kobo.
release_notes: An empty vault lists the commands that send your notes, and the setup guide lists the steps.

steps.text: Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Create the note shelf on the reader.
Send a folder of Markdown notes. Push again to update it.
